summary: Independent integrated-overlay review of cumulative fix-series v3 completed with approved candidate verdict and no Blocking Findings. Run 142 resolves Q1-RA-011 without weakening the bounded legacy recognizer or the C1 physical contract. Reader admission now retains an internal c1RunIds provenance set only for Runs that passed the schemaVersion 2/C1 discriminator path. validateImmutableRunResultRefs skips bounded legacy projections; artifact generation candidates and verification generation candidates are likewise restricted to C1-admitted Runs. Consequently schemaVersion 1 completed revise history (including the real baseline 136 and cumulative 138/140) is not retroactively required to carry C1 source-review ResultRefs; legacy explore/propose is not routed into C1 producedResultRefs/effective-set validation; and legacy review-apply does not become a C1 verification generation. Unknown schemaVersion values remain rejected by the unchanged three-way discriminator. The v2→v3 code delta is narrowly limited to retaining internal provenance and applying it at the three C1-only validation boundaries; no product registry, second Run domain, historical Run rewrite, or generic bypass was introduced. The Run-140 C1 semantics remain intact: valid pending revise uses context predecessor proof without terminal reviewVerdictRef; completed revise requires full immutable source-review tuple; failed/cancelled revise does not require terminal-only evidence and cannot become a successor; and any applicable immutable inputRef, consumedInputRefs or source-review failure prevents pending/completed revise from entering successor eligibility. Package integrity checks pass and all three changed TypeScript files parse with zero syntax diagnostics. No new Blocking or Non-blocking code findings were identified. This is a candidate-overlay approval only: Run 142 explicitly records that the complete dependency-installed repository focused/typecheck/lint/build/OpenSpec suite was not executed in the Author environment. The candidate is ready for owner-controlled mechanical application to the exact fixed baseline followed by real repository verification. This verdict does not authorize archive, checkpoint, Full Test, or final Delivery advancement.
